messages:
emma: Heads-up: nightly site build failed on linkcheck. A bunch of internal anchors 404 after we merged the mkdocs -> docusaurus content.

diego: Reproduced locally. The problem seems to be headings that include parentheses, emoji, or `:` — slug generation differs.

nora: Example from logs: `/docs/ops/observability#alerts:best-practices` -> 404, actual page has id `alerts-best-practices` (colon removed).

sam: Quick fix idea: run a post-parse step that normalizes anchor-style links to the Docusaurus slug form. Use the same slugger impl so it's deterministic.

emma: Agreed. Also saw some image paths like `![](/assets//img/...)` (double slash) coming from bad migration. Those confuse relative resolvers. Need small sanitizer for image paths too.

diego: I'll write a Node script: 1) parse markdown headings and compute docusaurus slugs, 2) scan all markdown links and replace fragment parts when they point to our docs but mismatch, 3) clean image src double-slashes and `../assets` -> `/docs/assets`. Dry-run mode first.

nora: Please ensure code blocks are not mutated (skip fenced code sections).

sam: Add tests: sample md with emoji heading, heading with parens, and an image with `../assets`. The script should output an index of edits for review.

doc-bot: PR opened: `docs: reconcile anchors + sanitize image paths (diego)`  checks started.

build-bot: CI: link-check step failed in first run (23 broken fragments).

diego: Pushed fixes and a dry-run report in the PR body showing 23 proposed fragment rewrites and 9 image path fixes.

emma: Review note: don't rewrite external anchors (e.g., `#section` on other domains). Limit replacements to links starting with `/docs` or relative `../`.

nora: Also add a small README note in docs/migration.md explaining the slug differences and how to author headings (prefer ascii-friendly ids if possible).

sam: After merge, we'll run a full `npx linkinator ./build -r` and have marketing spot-check a couple of pages.

doc-bot: PR link-check passed on latest push. Visual diff flagged one image that now points to `/docs/assets/old-diagram.svg`  reviewer confirmation needed.

emma: Confirmed that's expected (diagram moved). Approving.

doc-bot: PR merged. Staging deploy started at 1954320200.

build-bot: Staging link check completed: all internal fragments resolved.

diego: Updated migration guide and added the script usage example. Leaving TODO to monitor localized sites for unicode slug edge cases.

emma: Thanks all — closing thread once marketing signs off on the ja pages.
